units.text: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar Yaghi for the development of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), as confirmed by the Nobel Prize press release and the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announcement in Stockholm, Sweden.

units.text: The award recognizes the creation of porous molecular architectures (MOFs) with applications in gas storage, carbon capture, and catalysis, as detailed in the official announcement spans.

judgement.reason: The official announcement passages state the prize is for developing MOFs and that they can capture carbon dioxide, store toxic gases, and catalyse chemical reactions.

units.text: The announcement was made on 8 October 2025 by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, consistent with the standard venue for Nobel Chemistry Prizes in Stockholm, Sweden.
